scope: All 36 November candidates not covered by the earlier Josh McLaurin, statewide U.S. Senate, and Georgia House research passes. Candidate roster comes from the current election records.
method: Searched macon.com and maconmelody.com separately for each candidate; checked useful name variants, publisher election listings and matching identified republications. Saved verified metadata and candidate/author relationships only. Historical articles retain their original dates. This is a verified search result set, not an exhaustive archive inventory.
notes: Shared URLs reuse existing article rows and add associations; prior metadata and associations remain intact.
Fetched-on dates record the verification date, including publisher-index and matching syndication evidence where direct Telegraph access is blocked.
The eight governor write-ins were searched in both publications. No unambiguous candidate mention was verified; this does not establish that no coverage exists.
No fictitious people are created for collective staff bylines. Named authors and credited contributors are represented as people.
Opinion columns and historical election stories keep their titles and dates; associations do not imply endorsement or current candidacy in the historical office.
